BiblicalUsage: hâbar is how Scripture says to divide the heavens, an astrologer. In Isaiah 47:13, the text says "Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels. Let now the astrologers."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of hâbar I do not force more than it gives: to divide the heavens, an astrologer.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
